title: Filippo and Corrado conclude the structures are man-made

tellings.quote: we agree that it is something that it is man-made.

plain: Two researchers who scanned the ground under the Giza pyramids in Egypt have decided that what they found down there was built by people, not formed by nature. Filippo Biondi, one of the researchers behind the scans, says it on the show about himself and a colleague he calls Corrado: "we agree that it is something that it is man-made." If he is right, it would mean there are deliberately built structures deep beneath the plateau.
